subject: Onboarding: Medistat private deployment — network handoff & install cadence
messages:
From: Sara Green <sara.green@medistat.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: deploy@medistat.com
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment onboarding — network & HSM questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick response on the contract — we just signed and legal pushed it through this morning. We’re getting our implementation team aligned and have an initial set of networking + HSM questions before the kickoff call: 

- Do you support bringing your private control plane into our VPC via VPC peering or do you prefer PrivateLink-style endpoints? Our security team prefers least-privileged ingress.
- We need a high-level list of firewall rules, inbound/outbound ports and IP ranges for the on-prem appliance and the managed control plane.
- HSM: we’ll be using an in-house HSM (Thales), can Redwood integrate with customer HSMs or do we need Redwood-managed keys?
- Timeline: target start date for hands-on install is 2026-09-07. Is that feasible from Redwood’s side?

Could you loop in whoever owns the private deployment/ops checklist and share any pre-install artifacts you expect (network diagrams, install manifest, cert exchange process)?

Thanks,

Sara Green
Technical PM, Medistat Solutions

[Attachment: medistat_infra_summary.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Green <sara.green@medistat.com>
Cc: deploy@medistat.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-16T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding — network & HSM questions

Hi Sara — great to hear the contract cleared, congrats. I’m looping in our implementation leads (Marissa + Grace) and our infra lead (Marcus) so we can give concrete answers and a short pre-install checklist. Quick answers up front:

- Networking: we support both VPC peering and PrivateLink-style private endpoints. We typically recommend VPC peering for sustained low-latency connections; PrivateLink if you need a single-protocol controlled endpoint. We’ll propose a preferred pattern after reviewing your diagram.
- Firewall rules / IP ranges: we’ll attach a minimal port/IP matrix and preferred CIDR ranges in a separate note; expect NAT/egress rules for control-plane callbacks plus ELB/ingress ranges for private endpoints.
- HSM: we support customer-managed HSMs via our KMS bridge but will need the vendor docs and an operator for key ceremonies.
- Timeline: 09-07 is plausible; we have a 2-week preflight window (config + cert exchange) and a 1–2 day onsite/remote install depending on appliance access.

I’m attaching our install manifest and a draft network checklist for your team to review. Can you confirm who from Medistat will own the HSM operator/console access and whether there’s a preferred maintenance window for the cutover?

Next step: propose a 60-minute kickoff on 2026-08-19 to finalize owners and cadence. Does 10am PT work for you?

Cheers,

Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Implementation, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood_onprem_install_manifest.md (MD)
- redwood_network_port_matrix_v1.csv (CSV)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: sara.green@medistat.com, deploy@medistat.com
Date: 2026-08-16T12:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment onboarding — network & HSM questions

Folks — forwarding Medistat’s initial questions. Please see attachments (manifest + port matrix). Quick asks:

- Marissa: can you lead the install cadence & playbook? Owner for scheduling and runbook sign-off.
- Grace: you take security/compliance coordination (audit log retention, cert exchange process, SOC-2 evidence).
- Marcus: network owner — please produce a concise table of IP ranges, required ports, and whether we recommend VPC peering or PrivateLink for this account. Also confirm HSM integration path and any constraints with Thales.

I’d like short bullets by EOD 2026-08-17 so I can share with Sara in the kickoff. I’ve penciled the kickoff for 2026-08-19 10:00 PT (calendar invite pending).

Thanks —
Jonas

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: sara.green@medistat.com
Date: 2026-08-17T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment onboarding — network & HSM questions

Quick network note / draft deliverable:

- Recommendation: VPC peering for primary deployment (lower latency, simpler routing). We’ll offer a PrivateLink fallback for segmented environments.
- Control plane egress: allow outbound to 54.210.32.0/24 and 3.120.45.0/24 (Redwood control-plane pools), TCP 443.
- Appliance ingress (if you host the appliance on-prem and need remote ops): open TCP 22 (ops), TCP 443 (api), and UDP 123 (NTP) from our maintenance CIDR (will provide exact /32s).
- Healthchecks: outbound HTTPS to our health endpoint every 30s (stateful).
- HSM: Thales OK — we’ll use our KMS bridge. Required docs: key import/export policy, vendor operator contact, and network allowlist for HSM management port (vendor-dependent).

Attachments I’m sending to Jonas for final:
- medistat_network_diagram_v1.pdf
- hsm_requirements.xlsx

I’ll follow up with a one-pager (ip/port matrix) by morning 2026-08-18.

—Marcus
Network & Infra Lead, Redwood Inference

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Green <sara.green@medistat.com>, deploy@medistat.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Medistat onboarding plan & install cadence (next steps)

Hi Sara — following our internal sync, here’s a short installation cadence and ownership matrix so we can drive to the 2026-09-07 start. Please review and flag any conflicts.

1) Preflight (2026-08-21 through 2026-08-30) — objectives: cert exchange, NAT/IP confirmation, HSM operator onboarding
   - Deliverables from Medistat: finalized network diagram, HSM vendor operator contact, maintenance window preference. (Owner: Medistat)
   - Deliverables from Redwood: install manifest (attached), ip/port matrix (Marcus), cert exchange instructions (Grace). (Owner: Redwood)

2) Configuration & staging (2026-08-31 through 2026-09-04) — objectives: deploy appliance to staging, validate control-plane connectivity, run basic perf smoke tests
   - On-call: Marissa (install lead) + Marcus (network)

3) Cutover / install (target 2026-09-07) — objectives: enable traffic, hand over ops runbook, confirm metrics and logging
   - Onsite/remote: depends on appliance access; remote is expected for 80% of steps.

Attachments included: redwood_onprem_install_manifest.md, medistat_network_diagram_v1.pdf, hsm_requirements.xlsx, redwood_network_port_matrix_v1.csv

Links: kickoff notes and runbook draft at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-docs and tracker OPS ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4276

Can you please confirm the HSM operator contact and preferred maintenance window by 2026-08-22 so Marcus and Grace can finalize the port matrix and cert plan?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Implementation, Redwood Inference
